answer_1.quote: One of the key challenges in sign language processing is that methods from mainstream natural language processing (NLP) are tailored primarily to text and secondarily to speech.

answer_2.quote: Following prior works that evaluate on How2Sign, we report BLEU and BLEURT as our quantitative metrics.

answer_4.quote: Our annotators were the two middle authors, who are Deaf signers who use both ASL and English as primary languages; the other authors set up the test instances.
answer_4.guideline: How well could you understand the sentence in isolation? Pick one of 'not at all', 'somewhat', 'mostly', 'completely'. Is the clip signed in natural ASL? Pick one of 'no', 'eh', 'yes'.
